item.title: Version 3.1.2
item.description:
Thank you to @DavidDGTNT for catching #103 which was caused by a line ending normalization bug in the bundled gate libraries.

Windows sparkle updates are now signed and validated before downloading and on a fatal crash of the program it now checks if there is an update available and suggests downloading it before reporting.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/taciturnaxolotl/CedarLogic/compare/v3.1.1...v3.1.2
